$comment: Every slash command, with what it takes and what it does. The client answered sixty-odd and the composer offered seventeen of them, so most were findable only by already knowing they existed. Read by src/shared/commandlist.ts, carried to Kotlin by scripts/commands.py, and held to the switch in src/main/irc/commands.ts by tests/main/commandlist.test.ts.

commands.name: me
commands.summary: Say what you are doing, in the third person

commands.name: say
commands.summary: Send a message that begins with a slash

commands.name: msg
commands.summary: Message somebody without opening a conversation

commands.name: notice
commands.summary: Send a notice, which clients are not meant to answer

commands.name: cycle
commands.summary: Leave a channel and come straight back

commands.name: knock
commands.summary: Ask to be let into an invite-only channel

commands.name: topic
commands.summary: Read or set a channel's topic

commands.name: names
commands.summary: Ask who is in a channel

commands.name: list
commands.summary: Browse the channels on this network

commands.name: voice
commands.summary: Let somebody speak in a moderated channel

commands.name: admin
commands.summary: Make somebody a channel admin, where the network has them

commands.name: founder
commands.summary: Hand somebody the channel, where the network has founders

commands.name: kick
commands.summary: Put somebody out of the channel

commands.name: kickban
commands.summary: Ban and then kick, in that order

commands.name: quiet
commands.summary: Let somebody stay but not speak, where the network allows it

commands.name: whowas
commands.summary: Ask about somebody who has left

commands.name: ignore
commands.summary: Stop hearing from somebody, on this client

commands.name: setname
commands.summary: Change your real name without reconnecting

commands.name: motd
commands.summary: Read the message of the day

commands.name: lusers
commands.summary: How many people are on this network

commands.name: time
commands.summary: Ask the server what time it is

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Ask what the server is running

commands.name: links
commands.summary: List the servers on this network

commands.name: stats
commands.summary: Ask the server for a statistic

commands.name: wallops
commands.summary: Message every operator, if you are one

commands.name: help
commands.summary: List what you can type, or explain one command

commands.name: clear
commands.summary: Empty this conversation from the screen

commands.name: raw
commands.summary: Send a line to the server exactly as typed
